title: 多夫斯通学校上市提案
instruction:
您是 Netherfield Practice 的商业房地产销售代理人 Amara Bergqvist，正在准备 Northgale 理事会受托人在 14 10 月就处置已关闭的哈克尼斯小学大楼进行投票之前将看到的唯一提案。董事会主席 Solveig Ilechukwu 和其他受托人将在没有演示或发言时间的情况下阅读该数据包，设施总监 Tomas Lockhart 已经告诉几位受托人，Northgale 委员会可以通过使用内部密封投标来避免向经纪人付款。这一承诺需要被诚实对待，而不是悄悄重复或攻击。该委员会在投票前也只有一个董事会包的截止日期和有限的工作人员时间，因此一场完整的教科书营销活动是不现实的；为受托人提供一个可辩护的精益替代方案，并明确其限制。创建一个可供董事会使用的经纪参与提案，以赢得那些认为自己不需要经纪人的受托人的上市。它应该教会不熟悉商业经纪的读者正在做出什么决定，将密封投标方法与经纪流程进行比较，并说明为什么不同的买家群体——包括特许学校运营商、会众和老年人住房赞助商——可能会以不同的方式接触到。比较两个明确确定的时间段，并解释市场或交易案例中的任何重大变化，而不是提出没有支持的确定性。
包括透明的财务说明，其中包含假设、成本、收益、时间安排、风险以及敏感性或下行观点；无论出现在何处，数字都必须一致，并且不得捏造经过验证的市场事实、法律批准、分区权、估值或买方承诺。说明拟议的参与范围、报酬、期限、责任、冲突或排除、决策标准和一项明确的建议，并提供足够具体的所有权和时间安排，以便工作人员在受托人批准的情况下执行。保持不超过六页，使用适合民选官员的简单语言，避免系统指示和法律建议，并且不要以未来步骤清单结束。将`harkness_board_proposal.docx`和`harkness_board_proposal.pdf`都写入工作目录的顶层；它们必须包含相同的提案并就每个共同的数字达成一致。

---

将您完成的工作写入**当前工作目录的顶层**，使用以下文件名：
- `harkness_board_proposal.docx` — 董事会准备好的经纪参与提案和针对 Northgale 理事会受托人的简明教育简报。 （呈现时不得超过六页。；无需演示或口头解释即可理解。；必须使用通俗易懂的语言并包含一个明确的建议。；不得将捏造的市场事实、批准、估值或买家承诺作为经过验证的事实。；必须同意 PDF 中所有共享数据和实质性内容。）
- `harkness_board_proposal.pdf` — 同一经纪业务提案的渲染、董事会就绪的 PDF 版本。 （必须不超过六页。；必须是 DOCX 提案的忠实且可读的呈现。；必须同意 DOCX 的所有共享数据和实质性内容。）

除了这些文件名之外，不会收集任何内容。在其他地方或以任何其他名称编写的正确文件得分为零。

Harkness Elementary
Brokerage engagement proposal  |  Decision brief for Northgale Council trustees
DECISION REQUEST  Approve a 60-day, lean exclusive listing with Netherfield Practice before the 14 October board vote, subject to the terms on page 4.
1. The decision in plain language
Northgale Council is considering disposal of the closed Harkness Elementary building. Board president Solveig Ilechukwu and trustees will decide on 14 October. This packet is designed to stand alone: it explains what a broker adds, what it costs, and what remains the Council’s responsibility.
Facilities Director Tomas Lockhart has told several trustees that an in-house sealed bid could avoid paying a broker. That is a legitimate option: it can have low direct cost, a familiar public process, and administrative control. It is an informal expectation, not a binding engagement or board decision. We recommend acknowledging it in the staff report and showing the fee below so trustees can compare like with like.
2. Two workable routes
Route
What it does well
Where it is limited
In-house sealed bid
Council controls timetable and bid rules; no success fee in the illustration; straightforward audit trail.
Reach depends on Council’s list and staff time. Buyers may not understand school conversion questions; fewer qualified offers may mean less competition. Council staff carry inquiry, qualification, and negotiation load.
Lean brokered process (recommended)
Netherfield builds a verified fact sheet, targets distinct buyer groups, logs inquiries, screens capacity, runs a consistent offer process, and coordinates diligence. Wider reach and cleaner comparison can improve price discovery or certainty—but neither is guaranteed.
Success fee reduces proceeds; Council must provide records and approvals. A 60-day sprint cannot replicate a long campaign or establish zoning, condition, or value.
3. Who must hear about it—and why
Buyer group
Likely motivation
Information and outreach needed
Charter-school operators
Reuse classrooms, gym, and site for an education mission; may value occupancy timing.
Enrollment/program fit, room count, accessibility, parking/drop-off, utility capacity, and education-use approvals. Target known regional operators and education advisors with a concise fact sheet.
Congregations
Assembly, community programs, and worship space; may prioritize parking and flexible gathering rooms.
Assembly/use questions, life-safety and accessibility diligence, neighbors/noise, weekend access, and financing timeline. Use faith-community networks and a site walk.
Senior-housing sponsors
Adaptive reuse or redevelopment; may value location and building shell but need a longer approval path.
Condition, environmental, title, utilities, access, density/use pathway, and capital schedule. Target sponsors directly and require a credible diligence/approval plan.
A sealed-bid notice can reach any of these groups, but it does not by itself educate them or reveal which questions could disqualify a bid. Targeted contact is the incremental work a broker is being paid to perform.
4. Timing and market lens (illustrative, not local market facts)
The comparison below is a planning model only; Northgale has supplied no verified market statistics, valuation, buyer count, or commitment. It shows why the compressed pre-vote period changes the process choice.
Period
Operating context
Implication
Earlier planning window — 1 May–30 June 2026
More time for a broad campaign, multiple tours, and extended diligence. Illustrative target: 10 qualified inquiries and 3 offers.
Time could support more exposure, but the Council did not authorize a campaign in that window; those targets are not results.
Current pre-vote window — 24 Aug–14 Oct 2026
Seven weeks to assemble records, reach buyers, and give trustees a recommendation. Staff time is limited; board packet has one deadline.
Prioritize a verified fact sheet, three buyer-group lists, one tour, and a documented offer deadline. A lean brokered sprint preserves essential reach while accepting fewer tours and less price discovery than a full campaign.
5. Financial illustration and downside
Illustrative assumptions for comparison—not a valuation or forecast: gross purchase price $1,200,000; success fee 5.0% of gross purchase price; reimbursable marketing capped at $2,000; other seller closing costs $8,000. No taxes, debt payoff, or remediation are modeled.

Reconciliation: net = gross − fee − other costs. At the same $1,200,000 price, the brokered route costs $62,000 more than sealed bid. The brokered base therefore needs incremental price, certainty, or risk reduction worth more than $62,000 to be financially preferable; that outcome is possible, not promised. If price is $1,080,000, net is $1,016,000 and the fee does not disappear.
6. Proposed engagement: accountable and lean
Netherfield Practice will
Council / designated staff will
Prepare a one-page fact sheet from Council records; identify unknowns. Build and prioritize the three buyer lists; make direct outreach and one coordinated tour. Log every inquiry and material question. Receive offers through a single mailbox, acknowledge consistently, and deliver a comparison memo. Coordinate buyer requests, timeline, and closing handoffs.
Name one staff lead by 28 August; provide available plans, title/ownership records, known condition/environmental reports, utility/access information, and public-record constraints by 2 September. Approve fact sheet and outreach by 4 September; attend tour; answer factual questions; obtain all required public approvals and select the preferred offer.
Report conflicts before contacting a prospect; keep a dated activity and offer log available to Council.
Treat records and offers as subject to applicable public-record and procurement rules; direct legal, zoning, environmental, and tax questions to qualified advisers.
Milestones: kickoff 28 August; fact sheet approved 4 September; targeted outreach 4–18 September; tour and Q&A 22 September; offers requested by 2 October; comparison memo by 7 October; trustee vote 14 October. The 60-day term runs 28 August–26 October and ends if Council does not authorize a transaction, unless extended in writing.
Compensation: 5.0% of the gross purchase price payable only at closing, plus pre-approved third-party marketing expenses capped at $2,000. No fee is due if no closing occurs. Netherfield is not promising a buyer, price, zoning entitlement, environmental condition, title quality, financing, approval, or closing date. The Council remains responsible for disclosures, legal/procurement compliance, title, environmental and building diligence, zoning/use determinations, access, and all public approvals. Buyer interest or a proposed use is not evidence of entitlement, approval, condition, or suitability. Excluded: appraisal, engineering, environmental remediation, legal opinions, tax advice, and construction/development management.
7. Fair evaluation and recommendation
Staff should compare offers using a documented matrix: (1) net proceeds after stated costs; (2) price and deposit; (3) funding and diligence credibility; (4) closing timing and certainty; (5) public-owner risk allocation; and (6) mission/use fit, without presuming any use is approved. Material questions and answers should be shared consistently, and each offer should be time-stamped in the log.
RECOMMENDATION — Approve the 60-day lean brokered process with Netherfield Practice at the disclosed 5.0% success fee and $2,000 expense cap. It is the single option that adds targeted reach, qualification, fair comparison, and transaction coordination within the seven-week constraint. The sealed bid remains a respectable low-cost fallback if trustees decide that avoiding the modeled $62,000 same-price cost outweighs the uncertain value of broader exposure and managed execution; that tradeoff should be explicit in the vote record.
Prepared by Amara Bergqvist, Commercial Real Estate Sales Agent, Netherfield Practice

criteria.description: 该提案将哈克尼斯小学确定为一处关闭的学校财产，正在考虑由北风议会处置。
criteria.grader_hint: 搜索标题或开头上下文以了解财产、所有者和处置目的。

original.criterion: The proposal identifies Harkness Elementary as a closed school property being considered for disposal by Northgale Council.
original.grader_hint: Search the title or opening context for the property, owner, and disposal purpose.

criteria.description: 该提案确定了 14 10 月董事会决定，并将受托人作为决策受众。
criteria.grader_hint: 确认决策日期和受托人受众都是明确的。

original.criterion: The proposal identifies the 14 October board decision and addresses trustees as the decision audience.
original.grader_hint: Confirm both the decision date and trustee audience are explicit.

criteria.description: 该提案公平地解释了密封投标选项，包括至少一项合法优势，而不是对其进行讽刺。
criteria.grader_hint: 仅当内部选项被中立地描述为具有真正的好处（例如较低的直接成本、管理控制或程序简单性）时才授予奖励。

original.criterion: The proposal explains the sealed-bid option fairly, including at least one legitimate advantage rather than caricaturing it.
original.grader_hint: Award only if the in-house option is described neutrally with a real benefit such as lower direct cost, administrative control, or procedural simplicity.

criteria.description: 该提案解释了经纪流程在密封投标之外增加的内容，特别是更广泛的市场曝光、资格、竞争或交易管理。
criteria.grader_hint: 寻找独特的附加值，而不仅仅是经纪人经验丰富的断言。

original.criterion: The proposal explains what a brokered process adds beyond the sealed bid, especially broader market exposure, qualification, competition, or transaction management.
original.grader_hint: Look for distinct value added, not merely the assertion that a broker is experienced.

criteria.description: 该提案将特许学校运营商、会众和老年人住房赞助商视为不同的潜在买家群体。
criteria.grader_hint: 验证所有三个组都显示并且没有折叠到通用买家标签中。

original.criterion: The proposal discusses charter-school operators, congregations, and senior-housing sponsors as distinct potential buyer groups.
original.grader_hint: Verify all three groups appear and are not collapsed into a generic buyer label.

criteria.description: 该提案区分了三个买家群体可能的信息需求、动机或外展考虑因素。
criteria.grader_hint: 每个群体应该至少有一个与财产或交易相关的有意义的区别。

original.criterion: The proposal differentiates the likely information needs, motivations, or outreach considerations of the three buyer groups.
original.grader_hint: Each group should have at least one meaningful distinction tied to the property or transaction.

criteria.description: 该提案承认经纪人的报酬会减少总销售收益或增加公共所有者的交易成本。
criteria.grader_hint: 确认该费用为实际成本；不要将经纪业务描述为免费或无成本。

original.criterion: The proposal acknowledges that the broker's compensation reduces gross sale proceeds or increases transaction cost to the public owner.
original.grader_hint: Acknowledge the fee as a real cost; do not describe brokerage as free or costless.

criteria.description: 该提案坦诚而专业地处理了托马斯·洛克哈特的非正式的无经纪人费用承诺，没有指控他的不当行为，也没有将该承诺视为具有约束力的承诺。
criteria.evidence: 对现有计划的叙述性处理
criteria.grader_hint: 判断这种处理方式是否保留了信任，区分非正式的期望和批准的参与，并建议透明的披露。

original.criterion: The proposal handles Tomas Lockhart's informal no-broker-cost promise candidly and professionally without accusing him of misconduct or presenting the promise as a binding commitment.
original.grader_hint: Judge whether the treatment preserves trust, distinguishes an informal expectation from an approved engagement, and recommends transparent disclosure.

criteria.description: 该提案明确规定了经纪服务范围，涵盖营销、询价或买家管理、报价处理和交易协调。
criteria.grader_hint: 需要多种具体的服务类别，而不仅仅是“全方位服务经纪”。

original.criterion: The proposal states a clear scope of brokerage services covering marketing, inquiry or buyer management, offer handling, and transaction coordination.
original.grader_hint: Require multiple concrete service categories, not just 'full service brokerage.'

criteria.description: 该提案向 Netherfield Practice 和 Northgale Council 或其指定工作人员分配了有意义的职责。
criteria.grader_hint: 寻找双方可操作的业主分配，包括信息访问或理事会的批准。

original.criterion: The proposal assigns meaningful responsibilities to both Netherfield Practice and Northgale Council or its designated staff.
original.grader_hint: Look for actionable owner assignments on both sides, including information access or approvals by the council.

criteria.description: 该提案给出了与 14 10 月决定和压缩准备期相关的具体参与期限或里程碑窗口。
criteria.grader_hint: 接受日期、持续时间或里程碑，如果它们足够具体以执行并且与规定的截止日期相关。

original.criterion: The proposal gives a concrete engagement term or milestone window connected to the 14 October decision and the compressed preparation period.
original.grader_hint: Accept dates, durations, or milestones if they are specific enough to execute and tied to the stated deadline.

criteria.description: 该提案明确规定了薪酬结构，包括计算任何成功费用的基础。
criteria.grader_hint: 要求百分比或固定金额及其基数，例如总购买价格，加上可报销费用的处理（如果适用）。

original.criterion: The proposal states a compensation structure in unambiguous terms, including the basis on which any success fee would be calculated.
original.grader_hint: Require a percentage or fixed amount and its base, such as gross purchase price, plus treatment of reimbursable expenses if applicable.

criteria.description: 该提案确定了 Netherfield Practice 无法承诺提供的主要参与排除、依赖性或批准。
criteria.grader_hint: 寻找诸如分区、环境、所有权或公共批准依赖性等项目，并使用明确的非保证语言。

original.criterion: The proposal identifies the principal engagement exclusions, dependencies, or approvals that Netherfield Practice cannot promise to provide.
original.grader_hint: Look for items such as zoning, environmental, title, or public approval dependencies, with clear non-guarantee language.

criteria.description: 该提案将房产营销与保证买家、销售价格、批准或成交区分开来。
criteria.grader_hint: 当文件明确限制结果承诺，同时仍提出有说服力的案例时，授予奖项。

original.criterion: The proposal distinguishes marketing a property from guaranteeing a buyer, sale price, approval, or closing.
original.grader_hint: Award when the document expressly limits outcome promises while still making a persuasive case.

criteria.description: 该提案比较了两个明确标记的时间段，并确定了它们之间至少一项重大变化。
criteria.grader_hint: 这些时期必须是可识别的，并且变化必须被解释，而不仅仅是列出。

original.criterion: The proposal compares two explicitly labeled time periods and identifies at least one material change between them.
original.grader_hint: The periods must be identifiable and the change must be interpreted, not merely listed.

criteria.description: 用于期间比较的任何市场或交易数据都被标记为假设、说明性估计或具有适当基础的经过验证的事实。
criteria.grader_hint: 拒绝以实际当地市场数据形式提出的未经证实的主张；接受透明的说明性建模。

original.criterion: Any market or transaction figures used for the period comparison are labeled as assumptions, illustrative estimates, or verified facts with an appropriate basis.
original.grader_hint: Reject unsupported claims presented as actual local market data; accept transparent illustrative modeling.

criteria.description: 财务说明说明了总对价或价格假设、经纪报酬、其他确定的成本以及由此产生的净收益。
criteria.grader_hint: 所有四个组件都必须存在，否则模型不完整。

original.criterion: The financial illustration states a gross consideration or price assumption, brokerage compensation, other identified costs, and resulting net proceeds.
original.grader_hint: All four components must be present or the model is incomplete.

criteria.description: 财务插图以数学方式在 ±1% 的舍入容差范围内对总收益、费用、其他成本和净收益进行了调节。
criteria.grader_hint: 根据显示的假设重新计算；不需要任何特定的发明美元金额。

original.criterion: The financial illustration mathematically reconciles gross proceeds, fee, other costs, and net proceeds within rounding tolerance of ±1%.
original.grader_hint: Recalculate from the displayed assumptions; do not require any particular invented dollar amount.

criteria.description: 该提案比较了密封投标和经纪替代方案的财务或结果影响，但没有假装经纪结果是确定的。
criteria.grader_hint: 需要在直接成本和潜在影响力、竞争、价格或执行风险之间进行明确的权衡。

original.criterion: The proposal compares the financial or outcome implications of the sealed-bid and brokered alternatives without pretending that the brokered outcome is certain.
original.grader_hint: Require an explicit tradeoff between direct cost and potential reach, competition, price, or execution risk.

criteria.description: 该提案包括下行、敏感性或盈亏平衡视图，显示如果价格、时机、需求或成本与基本情况不同，建议将如何变化。
criteria.grader_hint: 如果假设和含义清晰且算术上一致，则简单的替代情况就足够了。

original.criterion: The proposal includes a downside, sensitivity, or break-even view showing how the recommendation changes if price, timing, demand, or costs differ from the base case.
original.grader_hint: A simple alternate case is sufficient if its assumptions and implication are clear and arithmetically consistent.

criteria.description: 资源限制是通过可靠的精益后备措施来解决的，该后备措施保留了必要的买家影响力和尽职调查，而不是简单地省略核心工作。
criteria.grader_hint: 判断后备方案是否可以在有限的员工时间下切实可行，以及其权衡是否得到承认。

original.criterion: The resource constraint is addressed with a credible lean fallback that preserves essential buyer reach and due diligence rather than simply omitting core work.
original.grader_hint: Judge whether the fallback is realistically executable with limited staff time and whether its tradeoffs are acknowledged.

criteria.description: 该提案给出了一个优先的营销或买家参与计划，以及具体的时间或所有权，而不是通用的促销渠道列表。
criteria.grader_hint: 需要优先级加上所有者或时间安排；通用的“市场广泛”语言是不够的。

original.criterion: The proposal gives a prioritized marketing or buyer-engagement plan with concrete timing or ownership rather than a generic list of promotional channels.
original.grader_hint: Require priorities plus owners or timing; generic 'market widely' language is insufficient.

criteria.description: 该提案描述了一种公平且有记录的方式来接收、比较或传达报价和重要的买家问题。
criteria.grader_hint: 寻找一致的处理、审计跟踪和对决策有用的比较信息。

original.criterion: The proposal describes a fair and documented way to receive, compare, or communicate offers and material buyer questions.
original.grader_hint: Look for consistent treatment, an audit trail, and decision-useful comparison information.

criteria.description: 该提案确定了与关闭的学校财产相关的尽职调查或适用性问题，包括条件、环境、所有权、分区/使用、访问或公共批准中的至少两项。
criteria.grader_hint: 要求至少两个具体类别，并解释它们为何影响买家或执行。

original.criterion: The proposal identifies due-diligence or suitability questions relevant to a closed school property, including at least two of condition, environmental, title, zoning/use, access, or public approvals.
original.grader_hint: Require at least two concrete categories and explain why they affect buyers or execution.

criteria.description: 该提案指出，买方兴趣或拟议用途本身并不构成分区权利、监管批准、条件或适用性。
criteria.grader_hint: 确认营销主张与权威批准或陈述之间的区别。

original.criterion: The proposal states that buyer interest or proposed use does not itself establish zoning entitlement, regulatory approval, condition, or suitability.
original.grader_hint: Confirm the distinction between marketing claims and authoritative approvals or representations.

criteria.description: 该提案定义了平衡收益或价格与时间、确定性、资格、公共所有者风险和/或使命契合度的决策标准。
criteria.grader_hint: 需要几个标准和理由；光靠价格并不能满足这个项目。

original.criterion: The proposal defines decision criteria that balance proceeds or price with timing, certainty, qualifications, public-owner risk, and/or mission fit.
original.grader_hint: Require several criteria and a rationale; price alone does not satisfy this item.

criteria.description: 该提案陈述了一种且仅有一种首选的行动方案，并将其与证据和规定的决策标准联系起来。
criteria.grader_hint: 结论必须做出单一决定，而不是提供同等的替代方案或将决定权留给读者。

original.criterion: The proposal states one and only one preferred course of action and ties it to the evidence and stated decision criteria.
original.grader_hint: The conclusion must make a single call, not offer equal alternatives or leave the decision to the reader.

criteria.description: 该建议对于持怀疑态度的公共受托人来说具有说服力，因为它承认密封投标的合法价值，使公共成本可见，并解释了经纪业务的增量收益。
criteria.grader_hint: 评估一个冷漠的读者是否能够理解为什么收费是合理的，而不觉得成本问题被回避了。

original.criterion: The recommendation is persuasive to skeptical public trustees because it concedes the sealed bid's legitimate value, makes the public cost visible, and explains the incremental benefit of brokerage.
original.grader_hint: Assess whether a cold reader could understand why the fee may be justified without feeling that cost concerns were evaded.

criteria.description: 提交的提案不超过六页。
criteria.evidence: 渲染的 PDF 和 DOCX 分页
criteria.grader_hint: 计算 PDF 页数并确认 DOCX 在渲染时不会超出相同的上限。

original.criterion: The rendered proposal is no more than six pages.
original.grader_hint: Count PDF pages and confirm the DOCX does not expand beyond the same cap when rendered.

criteria.description: 该提案可由受托人独立使用，无需现场演示，具有定义的术语、可读的表格或计算，并且没有必要的无法解释的速记。
criteria.grader_hint: 判断冷读可用性：受托人应该能够在不询问作者基本问题的情况下理解选择、经济、风险和建议。

original.criterion: The proposal is independently usable by trustees without a live presentation, with defined terms, readable tables or calculations, and no essential unexplained shorthand.
original.grader_hint: Judge cold-read usability: a trustee should be able to understand the choice, economics, risks, and recommendation without asking the author basic questions.

criteria.description: DOCX 和 PDF 包含相同的实质性提案，并就每个重复的数字、百分比、日期、持续时间和财务结论达成一致。
criteria.grader_hint: 提取并比较两个文件中重复的定量和实质性主张；只允许无害的分页或格式差异。

original.criterion: The DOCX and PDF contain the same substantive proposal and agree on every repeated figure, percentage, date, duration, and financial conclusion.
original.grader_hint: Extract and compare repeated quantitative and substantive claims across both files; allow only harmless pagination or formatting differences.

criteria.description: 两个必需的文件都位于工作目录的顶层，具有所请求的文件名和可用的 DOCX/PDF 格式。
criteria.evidence: 工作目录和文件元数据
criteria.grader_hint: 检查确切的基本名称、扩展名，以及每个文件是否以声明的媒体类型打开。

original.criterion: Both required files exist at the top level of the working directory with exactly the requested filenames and usable DOCX/PDF formats.
original.grader_hint: Check exact basenames, extensions, and that each file opens as the declared media type.

criteria.description: PDF 呈现时不会出现文本剪切、无法阅读的财务内容、表格损坏或页面缺失的情况，并且 DOCX 仍保持专业可读性。
criteria.grader_hint: 以正常阅读比例检查每一页；对阻碍受托人使用提案能力的布局失败进行处罚。

original.criterion: The PDF renders without clipped text, unreadable financial content, broken tables, or missing pages, and the DOCX remains professionally readable.
original.grader_hint: Inspect every page at normal reading scale; penalize layout failures that obstruct a trustee's ability to use the proposal.

review.selection: 沿用旧review-500中南杨c0–c3固定随机100题，未重抽、未挑题。

spec.professional_context: A commercial real estate agent is preparing a board-ready brokerage engagement proposal for a public owner disposing of a closed school property. The artifact must function both as a persuasive sales proposal and as a concise briefing that trustees can evaluate without a live presentation.
difficulty_sources: The proposal must persuade public trustees who believe a broker is unnecessary without dismissing the facilities director's existing plan.
The document must educate readers who will receive it without a presentation or opportunity for questions.
The practitioner must reconcile a prior informal promise about avoiding brokerage cost with transparent, defensible professional standards.
The practitioner must make a credible lean marketing recommendation despite a compressed board-packet deadline and limited staff capacity.
The proposal must compare two periods, model alternatives, and keep its figures consistent across two output formats.

authoring_plan.purpose: Construct an offline gold proposal and its faithful PDF rendering that demonstrate competent commercial brokerage judgment without relying on supplied files or live market facts.

gold_content.setting: Use Northgale Council as the public owner, Netherfield Practice as the brokerage, Harkness Elementary as the closed school asset, Amara Bergqvist as the agent, Solveig Ilechukwu as board president, and Tomas Lockhart as the facilities director. Do not introduce invented verified identities, addresses, account numbers, approvals, or buyer commitments.
gold_content.core_tension_one: Include a tactful acknowledgement that Tomas has informally suggested a no-broker-cost sealed bid. The gold should distinguish that expectation from a formal board decision, disclose the brokerage fee plainly, and avoid accusing Tomas or treating the promise as binding.
gold_content.core_tension_two: Model a compressed, staff-constrained marketing effort. Preserve essential exposure, qualification, offer handling, and diligence while prioritizing activities and identifying what a lean plan cannot do.
gold_content.period_comparison: Create two clearly labeled periods, such as an earlier planning period and the current pre-vote period. Use internally invented illustrative assumptions only, label them as such, and explain a material change such as a shift in buyer response, carrying time, or competitive exposure. Do not imply that the figures are verified local market statistics.
gold_content.financial_model: Choose a transparent hypothetical gross price or consideration, a clearly stated fee basis and rate or amount, any other modeled costs, and net proceeds. Add an alternate downside or sensitivity case. Derive every total arithmetically and repeat figures consistently wherever used.
gold_content.engagement_terms: Include scope, compensation, term or milestones, council and brokerage responsibilities, confidentiality or public-record considerations at a high level, conflicts or exclusions, non-guarantee language, and dependencies such as title, environmental, condition, zoning/use, access, and public approvals.
gold_content.buyer_segments: Treat charter-school operators, congregations, and senior-housing sponsors as distinct audiences. For each, connect likely motivation or diligence needs to the closed-school asset and explain why a sealed bid may not reach or educate them effectively.
gold_content.recommendation: Make one clear brokered-process recommendation, while fairly stating when the sealed bid could be attractive. Tie the recommendation to public value, reach, transparency, risk, timing, and the modeled economics. End the substantive document on the recommendation rather than an open-ended next-step list.

verification: Render the DOCX to PDF offline and verify the final PDF is at most six pages.
Recalculate base and sensitivity cases to within 1% and verify every repeated number, date, percentage, and conclusion agrees across both files.
Check that all rubric items are supported by visible artifact evidence and none depends on hidden reference material, a private code, or live internet data.
Confirm the proposal is comprehensible to trustees reading it cold and that no section promises legal, zoning, valuation, or buyer outcomes unsupported by the assumptions.

deliverables.description: A board-ready brokerage engagement proposal and concise educational briefing for Northgale Council trustees.
constraints: Must be no more than six pages when rendered.
Must be understandable without a presentation or oral explanation.
Must use plain language and include a single clear recommendation.
Must not present invented market facts, approvals, valuations, or buyer commitments as verified facts.
Must agree with the PDF on all shared figures and substantive content.

deliverables.description: The rendered, board-ready PDF version of the same brokerage engagement proposal.
constraints: Must be no more than six pages.
Must be a faithful and readable rendering of the DOCX proposal.
Must agree with the DOCX on all shared figures and substantive content.

original_instruction:
You are Amara Bergqvist, a commercial real estate sales agent at Netherfield Practice, preparing the only proposal that Northgale Council trustees will see before their 14 October vote on the disposal of the closed Harkness Elementary building. Board president Solveig Ilechukwu and the other trustees will read the packet without a presentation or speaking slot, and Facilities Director Tomas Lockhart has already told several trustees that Northgale Council can avoid paying a broker by using an in-house sealed bid. That promise needs to be treated honestly rather than quietly repeated or attacked. The council also has only one board-packet deadline and limited staff time before the vote, so a full textbook marketing campaign is not realistic; give the trustees a defensible lean alternative and make its limits clear. Create a board-ready brokerage engagement proposal that earns the listing from trustees who think they do not need a broker. It should teach a reader unfamiliar with commercial brokerage what decision is being made, compare the sealed-bid approach with a brokered process, and show why different buyer groups—including charter-school operators, congregations, and senior-housing sponsors—may be reached differently. Compare two clearly identified time periods and explain any material changes in the market or transaction case rather than presenting unsupported certainty. Include a transparent financial illustration with assumptions, costs, proceeds, timing, risks, and a sensitivity or downside view; figures must reconcile wherever they appear, and do not invent verified market facts, legal approvals, zoning rights, valuations, or buyer commitments. State the proposed engagement scope, compensation, term, responsibilities, conflicts or exclusions, decision criteria, and one clear recommendation, with enough concrete ownership and timing for staff to execute if trustees approve it. Keep it to no more than six pages, use plain language suitable for elected officials, avoid system instructions and legal advice, and do not end with a list of future steps. Write both `harkness_board_proposal.docx` and `harkness_board_proposal.pdf` into the top level of the working directory; they must contain the same proposal and agree on every shared figure.

---

Write your finished work to the **top level of the current working directory**, using exactly these filenames:

- `harkness_board_proposal.docx` — A board-ready brokerage engagement proposal and concise educational briefing for Northgale Council trustees. (Must be no more than six pages when rendered.; Must be understandable without a presentation or oral explanation.; Must use plain language and include a single clear recommendation.; Must not present invented market facts, approvals, valuations, or buyer commitments as verified facts.; Must agree with the PDF on all shared figures and substantive content.)
- `harkness_board_proposal.pdf` — The rendered, board-ready PDF version of the same brokerage engagement proposal. (Must be no more than six pages.; Must be a faithful and readable rendering of the DOCX proposal.; Must agree with the DOCX on all shared figures and substantive content.)

Nothing outside those filenames is collected. A correct file written anywhere else, or under any other name, scores zero.
